zstd-sys.reason: The published crate carries a copy of the zstd sources, whose every file offers its terms under either licence, at the user's option, and ships both texts (zstd/LICENSE, zstd/COPYING); the Cargo manifest names only BSD-3-Clause. The copy is not compiled: zstd-sys links the BCR zstd module.

rust-lang/rust.reason: The standard library reaches the binary through the toolchain rather than a fetched archive, so no licence text travels with it; https://github.com/rust-lang/rust/blob/master/LICENSE-MIT names this holder.

harfrust.reason: The published crate carries no licence file and its Cargo manifest no authors; https://github.com/harfbuzz/harfrust/blob/main/LICENSE names these holders.

zune-core.reason: The published crate carries no licence file and its Cargo manifest no authors; https://github.com/etemesi254/zune-image/blob/dev/LICENSE-MIT names this holder.

plasma-wayland-protocols/COPYING.LIB.reason: The crate generates its Rust protocol bindings from the KDE Plasma protocol definitions beside this text, seventeen of which are LGPL-2.1-or-later, so the terms do reach what bviz links. bviz accepts them under the terms this entry names, which "or later" permits and which Apache-2.0 is compatible with; the obligations that follow for anyone redistributing a bviz binary are discharged in NOTICE.
